title: Christmas Diagonal Stripe Pattern Bundle
author: Creative Gfx Arts
description:
# Christmas Diagonal Stripe Seamless Pattern Bundle | Holiday Candy Cane Digital Papers
Add a bold, festive, and modern touch to your holiday creations with this **Christmas Diagonal Stripe Seamless Pattern Bundle**. This collection includes 12 unique seamless diagonal stripe designs featuring classic Christmas colors, candy cane-inspired combinations, vibrant holiday tones, and stylish modern color palettes.
From traditional red and white stripes to green, mint, pink, black, gold, and multicolor combinations, these versatile patterns are perfect for Christmas crafting, gift wrapping, stationery, scrapbooking, fabric projects, digital designs, and print-on-demand products.
## ✨ You’ll Receive:
* 12 Unique Christmas Diagonal Stripe Pattern Designs
* 12 SVG Files
* 12 PNG Files
* 12 JPG Files
* All files delivered in one ZIP folder
* 3600 × 3600 px
* 300 DPI High-Resolution Quality
* Seamless repeating patterns for digital and print projects
## ✨ Perfect For:
👉 Christmas Gift Wrapping
👉 Holiday Cards and Invitations
👉 Christmas Scrapbooking
👉 Gift Tags and Packaging
👉 Holiday Stationery
👉 Digital Planners and Journals
👉 Fabric and Textile Designs
👉 Christmas Apparel and Accessories
👉 Stickers and Labels
👉 Sublimation Projects
👉 Print-on-Demand Products
👉 Christmas Party Decorations
👉 DIY Holiday Crafts
👉 Paper Crafts and Packaging
👉 Small Business Christmas Projects
## ✨ Important Information:
* This is a **digital download**. No physical product will be shipped.
* You will receive 12 unique seamless patterns in SVG, PNG, and JPG formats.
* All files are high-resolution and suitable for digital and print applications.
* The complete collection is delivered in one ZIP folder.
* Colors may vary slightly depending on your monitor, printer, and display settings.
* Please make sure your preferred software supports the included file formats before purchasing.
